installCommand: echo 'static files only, nothing to install'
buildCommand: mkdir -p _site && cp -r apps/public/. _site/ && for d in apps/demo-*/public; do n=$(basename $(dirname $d)); mkdir -p _site/$n && cp -r $d/. _site/$n/; done && cp -r lib assets _site/ && printf 'Page not found' > _site/404.html
